notes: The italic that is added as a subordinator the Hebrew writes no morpheme for, while the italic is is the construction-supplied copula and joins the predicate nominal (rules 55, 20).
men is a lexical subject noun supplied where the Hebrew writes only numerals, so it is added (rule 17).
Four waws in the closing numeral answer to four ands, each between the same pair of numerals (rule 42).
Both substantival articles take their supplied pronoun and relative and head on the pronoun (rule 41); kol keeps only every.
